City Council
AGENDA
la puente City Council
COUNCIL CHAMBERS
15900 EAST MAIN STREET, LA PUENTE
JULY 10, 2007
7:00
P.M.
CALL TO ORDER
ROLL CALL
COUNCILMEMBERS: Solis, Lujan, Chavez, Storing, Perez
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
If you wish to address the City Council on an item other than a public hearing matter, please complete the Request for Oral Presentation form and submit it to the City Clerk no later than prior to the conclusion of the first speaker's remarks. (Ordinance No. 06-843).
MINUTES OF PREVIOUS MEETINGS
A-1
READ AND APPROVE THE MINUTES OF THE SPECIAL MEETING OF JUNE 27, 2007
It is recommended that the City Council waive the reading of the Special Meeting of June 27, 2007.
Minutes June 27, 2007
PUBLIC HEARINGS
B-1
CONSIDERATION OF AN AWARD OF AN EXCLUSIVE FRANCHISE TO PROVIDE TAXICAB SERVICE IN THE CITY OF LA PUENTE
It is recommended that the City Council authorize the City Manager to negotiate and return to Council for approval of a final agreement with Yellow Cab Company of San Gabriel Valley to provide exclusive taxi service in the City of La Puente in conformance with the terms set forth in the Request for Qualifications and the proposal submitted.
Exclusive Franchise Report
B-2
PUBLIC HEARING TO CONSIDER AN ORDINANCE AND RESOLUTION ESTABLISHING A SANITARY SEWER CAPACITY CHARGE BASED ON SEWER CAPACITY CHARGE/ANALYSIS PREPARED BY HILTON FARNKOPF AND HOBSON
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) open the Public Hearing; (2) receive Public input; (3) read by title only and waive further reading of the ordinance adding Chapter 4.14 of the La Puente Municipal Code Establishing a Sanitary Sewer Capacity Charge to be Imposed Upon New and Expanded Connections to the City's Sanitary Sewer System; (4) introduce the ordinance for subsequent adoption; and (5) adopt the resolution imposing a sanitary sewer capacity charge.
Sanitary Sewer Capacity Report
Ordinance - Sanitary Sewer
Reso. - Sanitary Sewer
UNFINISHED BUSINESS
C-1
SPECIFIC PLAN AMENDMENT NO. 06-01 - A PROPOSAL TO AMEND THE LA PUENTE DOWNTOWN BUSINESS DISTRICT SPECIFIC PLAN TO CHANGE TO SPECIFIC PLAN LAND USE DESIGNATION FROM COMMUNITY SERVICES TO MULTI-FAMILY RESIDENTIAL (Introduced and title read at meeting of June 26, 2007)
It is recommended that the City Council adopt the Ordinance enacting the Downtown Business District Specific Plan Amendment No. 06-01.
Specific Plan Amendment No 06-01
CONSENT CALENDAR
All matters listed under Consent Calendar are considered to be routine in nature and may be enacted by one motion approving the recommendation listed on the Agenda. One or more items may be removed from the Consent Calendar so that said item(s) may be discussed and considered individually by the City Council, if a motion to remove the item(s) is approved by an affirmative vote of a majority of the members of the City Council. Those specific item(s) will be considered as the first item under New Business.
D-1
CONSIDERATION OF RESOLUTION APPROVING WARRANT REGISTER NO. 1206 FOR FISCAL YEAR 2006-07
It is recommended that the City Council adopt the resolution.
W/R 1206
D-2
AWARD OF CONTRACT FOR ASBESTOS/LEAD TESTING CONSULTING SERVICES
It is recommended that the City Council authorize the Mayor to execute the Agreement for Community Development Block Grant asbestos/lead-testing consulting services with Global Environmental.
Asbestos/Lead Award Report
D-3
AWARD OF CONTRACT FOR THE INSTALLATION OF ELECTRIC GATE OPENERS AT THE LA PUENTE SENIOR CENTER
It is recommended that the City Council award the bid to California Automatic Gate and Door Enterprise in the amount of $13,035.00 and authorize the Mayor to execute the Agreement with California Automatic Gate and Door Enterprise for gate operator installation at the Senior Center.
Electric Gate Opener Award Report
NEW BUSINESS
E-1
CONSIDERATION OF RESOLUTION ESTABLISHING THE CITY OF LA PUENTE PARK AND RECREATION COMMISSION
It is recommended that the City Council adopt the Resolution establishing the La Puente Parks and Recreation Commission and direct Staff to advertise the appointment of commission members.
Park and Recreation Commission Report
Reso - Park and Recreation Commission
Recruitment Application Notice
E-2
CONSIDERATION OF AUTHORIZATION TO ADVERTISE AND REQUEST BIDS FOR THE REMOVAL OF ASBESTOS AND LEAD AT THE LA PUENTE COMMUNITY CENTER
It is recommended that the City Council authorize Staff to advertise for bids for asbestos/lead containing building material abatement at the La Puente Community Center.
Asbestos and Lead - Community Ctr. Report
Spec - Asbestos and Lead - Com. Ctr.
E-3
CONSIDERATION OF A TRAFFIC STUDY TO INSTALL RED LIGHT CAMERAS
It is recommended that City Council authorize Staff to proceed with recommended traffic study.
Traffic Study Report
E-4
CONSIDERATION OF SENDING A LETTER OF OPPOSITION TO SENATE BILL 1020
It is recommended that the City Council authorize the Mayor to sign a letter of opposition to Senate Bill 1020.
Senate Bill 1020 Report
Letter
COUNCIL AB1234 REPORTS
ORAL COMMENTS FROM COUNCIL
ORAL COMMENTS FROM STAFF
RECESS TO CLOSED SESSION

City Council
MINUTES
LA PUENTE CITY COUNCIL
REGULAR MEETING OF
July 10, 2007
A Regular Meeting of the City Council of the City of La Puente was held in the Council Chambers of City Hall, 15900 East Main Street, La Puente, California, on July 10, 2007, at 7:00 p.m.
CALL TO ORDER
ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
MINUTES OF PREVIOUS MEETINGS
A-1
READ AND APPROVE THE MINUTES OF THE SPECIAL MEETING OF JUNE 27, 2007
Minutes June 27, 2007
Lujan moved to approve the minutes of the Special Meeting of June 27, 2007;; seconded by Chavez.
The motion unanimously carried by the following roll call vote: AYES: Storing, Lujan, Chavez, and Perez. NOES: None.
PUBLIC HEARINGS
B-1
CONSIDERATION OF AN AWARD OF AN EXCLUSIVE FRANCHISE TO PROVIDE TAXICAB SERVICE IN THE CITY OF LA PUENTE
Exclusive Franchise Report
Storing moved to direct staff to negotiate and return to Council for approval, a final agreement with Yellow Cab Company of San Gabriel Valley to provide exclusive taxi service in the City of La Puente in conformance with the terms set forth in the Request for Qualifications and the proposal submitted. ; seconded by Lujan.
The motion unanimously carried by the following roll call vote: AYES: Storing, Lujan, Chavez, and Perez. NOES: None.
B-2
PUBLIC HEARING TO CONSIDER AN ORDINANCE AND RESOLUTION ESTABLISHING A SANITARY SEWER CAPACITY CHARGE BASED ON SEWER CAPACITY CHARGE/ANALYSIS PREPARED BY HILTON FARNKOPF AND HOBSON
Sanitary Sewer Capacity Report
Ordinance - Sanitary Sewer
Reso. - Sanitary Sewer
Perez moved to adopt the resolution imposing a sanitary sewer capacity charge; ; seconded by Lujan.
The motion unanimously carried by the following roll call vote: AYES: Storing, Lujan, Chavez, and Perez. NOES: None.
UNFINISHED BUSINESS
C-1
SPECIFIC PLAN AMENDMENT NO. 06-01 - A PROPOSAL TO AMEND THE LA PUENTE DOWNTOWN BUSINESS DISTRICT SPECIFIC PLAN TO CHANGE TO SPECIFIC PLAN LAND USE DESIGNATION FROM COMMUNITY SERVICES TO MULTI-FAMILY RESIDENTIAL (Introduced and title read at meeting of June 26, 2007)
Specific Plan Amendment No 06-01
Chavez moved to adopt the ordinance enacting the Downtown Business District Specific Plan Amendment No. 06-01; ; seconded by Storing.
The motion unanimously carried by the following roll call vote: AYES: Storing, Lujan, Chavez, and Perez. NOES: None.
CONSENT CALENDAR
Action Taken : All matters listed under Consent Calendar are considered to be routine in nature and may be enacted by one motion approving the recommendation listed on the Agenda. One or more items may be removed from the Consent Calendar so that said item(s) may be discussed and considered individually by the City Council, if a motion to remove the item(s) is approved by an affirmative vote of a majority of the members of the City Council. Those specific item(s) will be considered as the first item under New Business.
D-1
CONSIDERATION OF RESOLUTION APPROVING WARRANT REGISTER NO. 1206 FOR FISCAL YEAR 2006-07
W/R 1206
D-2
AWARD OF CONTRACT FOR ASBESTOS/LEAD TESTING CONSULTING SERVICES
Asbestos/Lead Award Report
D-3
AWARD OF CONTRACT FOR THE INSTALLATION OF ELECTRIC GATE OPENERS AT THE LA PUENTE SENIOR CENTER
Electric Gate Opener Award Report
Chavez moved to approve Items No. D-1 though D-3 on the Consent Calendar.; seconded by Lujan.
The motion unanimously carried by the following roll call vote: AYES: Storing, Lujan, Chavez, and Perez. NOES: None.
NEW BUSINESS
E-1
CONSIDERATION OF RESOLUTION ESTABLISHING THE CITY OF LA PUENTE PARK AND RECREATION COMMISSION
Park and Recreation Commission Report
Reso - Park and Recreation Commission
Recruitment Application Notice
Perez moved to adopt the resolution establishing the La Puente Parks and Recreation Commission and direct staff to advertise the appointment of Commission members; ; seconded by Lujan.
The motion unanimously carried by the following roll call vote: AYES: Storing, Lujan, Chavez, and Perez. NOES: None.
E-2
CONSIDERATION OF AUTHORIZATION TO ADVERTISE AND REQUEST BIDS FOR THE REMOVAL OF ASBESTOS AND LEAD AT THE LA PUENTE COMMUNITY CENTER
Asbestos and Lead - Community Ctr. Report
Spec - Asbestos and Lead - Com. Ctr.
Chavez moved to approve the authorization for Staff to advertise for bids for asbestos/lead containing building material abatement at the La Puente Community Center. ; seconded by Lujan.
The motion unanimously carried by the following roll call vote: AYES: Storing, Lujan, Chavez, and Perez. NOES: None.
E-3
CONSIDERATION OF A TRAFFIC STUDY TO INSTALL RED LIGHT CAMERAS
Traffic Study Report
Lujan moved to authorize staff to proceed with the recommended traffic study; seconded by Perez.
The motion unanimously carried by the following roll call vote: AYES: Storing, Lujan, Chavez, and Perez. NOES: None.
E-4
CONSIDERATION OF SENDING A LETTER OF OPPOSITION TO SENATE BILL 1020
Senate Bill 1020 Report
Letter
Perez moved to authorize the Mayor to sign a letter of opposition of Senate Bill 1020 ; seconded by Chavez.
The motion unanimously carried by the following roll call vote: AYES: Storing, Lujan, Chavez, and Perez. NOES: None.
